title: Modeled false-failure chance for fifty tests
method: Hypothetical independent equal-probability tests: suite false-failure probability = 100 × (1 − (1−p)^50). p=0.005 gives 22.17%; p=0.001 gives 4.88%. Real shared causes violate independence; these are not observed rates.
alt: Modeled false-failure chance for fifty tests. 0.5% per test: 22.17 percent; 0.1% per test: 4.88 percent. Illustrative inputs.
